data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 62–63):** **`إِلَىٰ`** ka matlab **'ki taraf / tak'** hai. Iske baad aane wale ism ke neeche **Zair (`ـِ / ـٍ`)** aati hai: `إِلَى الْكِتَابِ` (Kitaab ki taraf), `مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ` (andheron se roshni ki taraf).

data.text: Upar ki misalon se wazeh hai ke (إِلَىٰ) ke maani 'ki taraf' hain, aur iske baad aane wale lafz ke aakhir mein aam taur par zer (kasrah) aati hai. data.text: Do alfaaz [التَّهْلُكَةِ] aur [الدَّاعِي] par chokor box banaya gaya hai. Kyun? Kyunki yeh naye alfaaz hain aur iss tarah khaas taur par wazeh kiye gaye hain. Agar aap naye alfaaz jaldi yaad karna chahte hain toh unhein isi tarah highlight karein taake baar baar dhyan jaye aur jaldi yaad ho sakein.
